name: Voxel Surge Demo
author: jim
description_short: A voxel mech roguelite: drop into the shaft, blast through swarms, stack upgrades and descend 10,000 m to face the Titan.
description_long: Voxel Surge is a fast mech roguelite built for the GameCube. Pick a class and a build path, then fall through floating sectors full of enemies, rivals and bosses. Every level up offers new weapons, passives and evolutions; every floor rolls its own effect. This demo runs from the first sector to the Titan, with split-screen co-op and versus. Music and saves live in SD:/voxelsurge.
